headline: Grip is a budget. Battery is life.
text:
Grip is a budget. The battery is your life.

Built an EV drift racer with real weight-transfer physics & regen braking into a single HTML file. Zero load time, zero ads.

Slide & recharge ⚡️
https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A smooth 6-second looping GIF/video showing a high-speed weight-transfer drift around a snow-covered bend, with the battery regen UI flashing green during the slide.
